tables.name: ucl_meta
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE ucl_meta (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: capability
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE capability (
  canonical_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  canonical_url    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  duplicate_group  TEXT NOT NULL,
  title            TEXT NOT NULL,
  description      TEXT NOT NULL,
  host             TEXT NOT NULL,
  category         TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind             TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind_basis       TEXT NOT NULL,
  capability_certainty TEXT NOT NULL,
  license          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
  license_evidence TEXT,
  version          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
  trust_state      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVETTED',
  installed        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
  security         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_TESTED',
  compatibility    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_TESTED',
  cost_micros      TEXT,
  cost_currency    TEXT,
  cost_basis       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
  raw_digest       TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen        TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: source_record
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE source_record (
  snapshot_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  original_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  canonical_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES capability(canonical_id),
  source        TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_row    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  locator       TEXT NOT NULL,
  url           TEXT NOT NULL,
  raw_digest    TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_flags  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id, original_id)
)

tables.name: capability_tag
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE capability_tag (
  canonical_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES capability(canonical_id),
  tag          TEXT NOT NULL,
  tag_kind     TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 'capability' | 'hazard'
  certainty    TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (canonical_id, tag, tag_kind)
)

tables.name: import_snapshot
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE import_snapshot (
  snapshot_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_sha   TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_rows  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  imported_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
  body_digest  TEXT NOT NULL,
  status       TEXT NOT NULL       -- 'IMPORTED' | 'REPLAY'
)

tables.name: blueprint
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE blueprint (
  blueprint_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  version       TEXT NOT NULL,
  status        TEXT NOT NULL,
  role          TEXT NOT NULL,
  purpose       TEXT NOT NULL,
  body          TEXT NOT NULL,     -- canonical JSON of the full record
  recipe_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
  revoked_reason TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (blueprint_id, version)
)

tables.name: submission
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE submission (
  submission_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tool_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
  at                TEXT NOT NULL,
  eligible          INTEGER NOT NULL,
  proposable        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reason            TEXT NOT NULL,
  submission_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload           TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: qualification
tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE qualification (
  tool_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state          TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope          TEXT NOT NULL,
  receipt_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  receipt        TEXT NOT NULL,
  issued_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at     TEXT,
  issuer         TEXT NOT NULL,
  revoked_at     TEXT,
  revoke_reason  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (tool_id, revision)
)

tables.name: capability_fts
tables.schema:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE capability_fts USING fts5(
  canonical_id UNINDEXED,
  title,
  description,
  tags,
  tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'
)

tables.name: capability_fts_data
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE 'capability_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

tables.name: capability_fts_idx
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE 'capability_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: capability_fts_content
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE 'capability_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3)

tables.name: capability_fts_docsize
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE 'capability_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

tables.name: capability_fts_config
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE 'capability_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
